label: Addiction
assignment: Discover realistic substance-use recovery resources for people in {service_area}, from immediate withdrawal and overdose safety through outpatient, residential, medication, peer, and long-term recovery support. Verify clinical level of care, payment, eligibility, current openings, referral requirements, and the real admission path.
include: Withdrawal management, overdose prevention, medication treatment, and urgent clinical assessment
Outpatient, intensive outpatient, residential, and inpatient treatment
Peer recovery, support groups, recovery coaching, and family support
Sober living, recovery housing, transportation, and treatment-linked practical support
Publicly funded, Medicaid, uninsured, youth, pregnancy, reentry, and other specialized pathways
exclude: General mental-health care with no confirmed substance-use service
Treatment marketing or referral brokers that do not identify the actual provider and costs
Recovery residences whose rules, oversight, fees, or current availability cannot be established
verificationQuestions: What level of care is offered and who performs the assessment?
Is medication treatment available, and which medications or prescribers are supported?
What insurance, Medicaid, self-pay, or public-funding options and costs apply?
Are beds or appointments currently available and how does admission begin?

stages.title: Urgent safety and assessment
stages.instruction: Investigate overdose prevention, naloxone, crisis response, withdrawal management, urgent assessments, medication access, and immediate admission pathways. Distinguish medical emergency care from routine treatment entry.

stages.title: Treatment levels and payment
stages.instruction: Investigate outpatient, intensive outpatient, residential, and inpatient programs; clinical services; payment and public funding; waitlists; transportation; and the actual assessment and admission sequence.

stages.title: Recovery and specialized support
stages.instruction: Investigate peer and family support, recovery coaching, sober living, youth and pregnancy services, reentry pathways, culturally and linguistically appropriate care, and support for co-occurring conditions.

stages.title: Continuity and gap review
stages.instruction: Check transitions between detoxification, treatment, medication, housing, and ongoing recovery. Verify current capacity, avoid treatment brokers, and identify population, payment, geographic, and after-hours gaps.
